# The task and the data

> **At the moment of hospital discharge**, predict whether an adult with diabetes will be **readmitted within 30 days**.

The model will help a nurse follow-up program decide which discharged patients to call for support. Each row is one hospital stay. All data are simulated.

| Variable | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `stay_id` | Unique ID for each hospital stay | Text |
| `patient_id` | Unique ID for each patient (a patient can have more than one stay) | Text |
| `age_group` | Age at admission | 18-44, 45-64, 65-74, 75-84, 85+ |
| `sex` | Sex recorded at admission | Female, Male |
| `race` | Race recorded at registration | White, Black, Hispanic, Asian, Other; blank = not recorded |
| `insurance` | Primary payer at admission | Medicare, Medicaid, Private, Self-pay; blank = not recorded |
| `admission_type` | Type of admission | Emergency, Urgent, Elective |
| `primary_dx` | Primary diagnosis group for this stay | Circulatory, Respiratory, Diabetes, Digestive, Injury, Other |
| `length_of_stay` | Days from admission to discharge | Days; valid range 1–14 |
| `num_medications` | Number of distinct medications given during the stay | Count |
| `num_diagnoses` | Number of diagnoses recorded for the stay | Count |
| `prior_inpatient` | Inpatient admissions in the 12 months before this stay | Count |
| `prior_er` | Emergency visits in the 12 months before this stay | Count |
| `a1c_result` | HbA1c result during the stay | Normal, High; blank = not tested |
| `discharge_to` | Discharge destination | Home, Home health, Facility (SNF), Hospice, Died |
| `followup_call_30d` | Care-management phone call completed in the 30 days after discharge | Yes, No |
| `readmit_30d` | **OUTCOME:** readmitted within 30 days of discharge | Yes, No |

# Part 1 setup

Part 1 uses data from **Northfield Health**.

```{r setup}
pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "tidymodels", "themis", "ranger", "gtsummary", "naniar", "probably")
missing_pkgs <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(themis)
library(gtsummary)
library(naniar)
library(probably)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(2026)

# "Yes" is the first level, so tidymodels treats readmission as the event
northfield <- read_csv("data/northfield_readmission.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(readmit_30d = factor(readmit_30d, levels = c("Yes", "No")))
```

# Build two models (15 min)

Fit **logistic regression** and at least **one other model**: random forest, SVM, XGBoost, LASSO, naive Bayes, or another. Train on `train` only.

**Useful functions:**

- `recipe(readmit_30d ~ ., data = train)` with `step_rm()` (IDs and unused variables), `step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors())`, `step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())`
- `logistic_reg()`, `rand_forest(mode = "classification")`, `svm_rbf(mode = "classification")` (needs kernlab), `boost_tree(mode = "classification")` (needs xgboost)
